development_notes_set_A.primary_choice: mu span 50 = the shipped span, so the comparison with M0 isolates the definition. On A the span of s changed nothing in the reference (MAE 0.3063 vs 0.3064) and span 100 gave a z-score slightly closer to unit sd (1.059 vs 1.075), so M2_50_100.
development_notes_set_A.slow_scale: M2_50_250 added on A after the scale feedback was seen; run once elsewhere.
development_notes_set_A.rebased_multiple: 2.2 = the multiple of M2 whose pooled frequency on A equals 2x M0 (2.215), rounded.
development_notes_set_A.tried_on_A_and_dropped: scales that ignore upward moves (downside-only EWMA; clip at 2 s or 1.5 s for the scale only), spans 100 and 250, frequency-matched thresholds. They traded post-spike sensitivity (flag rate 11-30 bars after a spike at 0.61-0.78 of the stock's calm rate) against cross-stock comparability (CV of the per-stock frequency 0.20-0.33 against 0.17 for the z-score). No clear gain; not kept.

definitions.analysis_rows: eval rows with volume > 0 and every estimator finite
definitions.err: ln(volume) - ln(normal), normal from bars <= t-1
definitions.sd_ln_volume: per-stock sd of the M1 innovation ln V - EWMA50(ln V) on analysis rows
definitions.sd_pre: the same sd on bars 100..399 of each stock (before the evaluation window)
definitions.spike: volume >= 5 x M3 (median of the previous 50 bars)
definitions.C4: mean over rows k bars after the last spike of ln(V/normal) minus the stock's own mean
definitions.units: rates in percent of bars; x 2.52 = events per stock per year
definitions.independence: A = development. B shares A's dates. DJ lies inside LH. MS is new.
